caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular lantern with a wooden frame, shown against a plain, beige background. The lantern has four vertical wooden posts at the corners and a flat, square wooden base and roof. The wood is colored in brown tones, with the edges and surfaces showing shading and texture. Inside the lantern, there is a short, white cylindrical candle with a visible black wick, placed on a small, rectangular support that resembles a book or slab, colored in a tan shade. The sides of the lantern appear to have translucent or glass panels, illustrated with grayish and brownish hues that suggest reflections or grime. On top of the lantern, there is a metal handle, colored in gray, and a curved, metallic piece that arches over the roof. The lantern rests on four short, square feet extending below each corner of the base.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
